format: zip of a PSP save folder for a PSone Classic (PARAM.SFO, ICON0.PNG, CONFIG.BIN, SCEVMC0.VMP and SCEVMC1.VMP): each .VMP is '\0PMV' 128-byte header + 131072-byte card, slot 1 and slot 2; the card holds 10 save(s), 10 for this game (BASCUS-94491drgn0000, BASCUS-94491drgn0001, BASCUS-94491drgn0002, BASCUS-94491drgn0003, ...)

Only SCEVMC0.VMP (memory card slot 1) is converted and loaded; SCEVMC1.VMP is slot 2 and holds 10 more save(s). one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: this archive holds 2 cards: SCUS94491/SCEVMC0.VMP, SCUS94491/SCEVMC1.VMP
